title: Cleaning Brush for Lawn Mower & Patio – 10 Inches, 3-Prong
descriptionHtml:
Moss and dirt between the slabs – by hand?

Scrubbing the patio, the deck and the garage driveway on your knees with a hand brush takes hours and wears on your back. And an ordinary brush loses its stiffness after a couple of uses.

Scrub standing up – in half the time

The 3-prong nylon brush head attaches to your lawn mower or drill and scrubs away moss, dirt and algae – without damaging slate, wood or cobblestone. You stand upright and let the tool do the job.

Features

  • Gentle on floors – nylon bristles that don't scratch the surface.
  • 3-prong design – reaches into joints and corners.
  • Durable material – keeps its stiffness season after season.
  • Fits lawn mowers and drills.
  • 10 inches – covers a large area quickly.

Changing your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
